profile.headline: Software Engineer - Highly adaptable with very strong organizational and analytical skills

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Project: C2imera(SPA Core Team)

Developed and maintained complex React components, contributing to a dynamic, data-driven UI used for mission-critical operational tracking.

Utilized React, TypeScript, Redux, and Material-UI (MUI) to build highly configurable components and panels with dynamic behavior based on location (workspace).

Implemented state-driven conditional logic using Redux and selector patterns, including custom hooks for safe and optimized state access.

Created user-friendly UIs that respond to a variety of backend system types.

Designed interaction logic for updating and validating conditional inputs, including dynamically loaded options, value resets, and form validation patterns.

Built custom UI controls with advanced logic to support bulk updates, rationale tracking, and responsive layouts for both individual and board-level configurations.

Maintained clean and testable code using Jest for unit tests and Cucumber for behavior-driven end-to-end testing.


Project: AFCTC(ATLAS Team)

Simulation & Training Systems Developer
Spearheaded the development of a virtual simulation system to support battalion-level force-on-force training at U.S. military facilities, enhancing realism and mission readiness.
Engineered a real-time situational awareness platform, integrating live audio, video, and performance metrics for after-action review by commanders and trainees.
Led the design and implementation of the core training software module responsible for near real-time position tracking and data acquisition from field participants.
Contributed to system architecture and built a graphical user interface for exercise analysts, enabling dynamic data visualization and scenario control.
Developed a mobile GPS-based training solution to extend live simulation capabilities to field environments, increasing operational flexibility and immersion.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Engineer – Autonomous Systems Division, L3Harris Technologies

Developed software solutions supporting L3Harris's multi-domain autonomous platforms, including air, land, and maritime systems, contributing to mission-critical capabilities for defense, surveillance, and situational awareness.

Designed and implemented back-end services in Java to support real-time data processing, mission control logic, and system integration for unmanned aerial (FVR Series), ground (Diamondback™), and maritime vehicles.

Built and maintained responsive user interfaces for internal tools and operator dashboards, ensuring secure and intuitive interaction with autonomous system control modules.

Collaborated with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance autonomous navigation, payload management, and system diagnostics within modular open systems architectures.

Contributed to systems leveraging the Foresight Autonomy Suite and ASView™ control technologies, supporting advanced autonomy features such as waypoint navigation, real-time command and control, and situational simulation environments.
positions.insights: Cucumber, Agile Project Management and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Front-End Developer / Web Application Support
Played a key role in modernizing legacy web pages to improve responsiveness and enhance user interaction across multiple platforms.
Developed application-level code to interface with APIs and web services using AJAX and JSON, ensuring efficient and seamless data integration.
Contributed to the definition of application design standards, development workflows, and deployment best practices for web service infrastructure.
Implemented client-side validation logic using JavaScript and jQuery, improving form integrity and user experience.
Maintained and continuously enhanced the front-end of enterprise-level web applications, recommending tailored solutions aligned with evolving business and technical requirements.
Responsible for maintaining over 150 active websites, delivering timely hotfixes and performing on-demand page updates based on direct customer requests and priority needs.
positions.insights: JavaServer Pages (JSP), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Engineer – Autonomic Logistics Information System (ALIS), Lockheed Martin

Contributed to the development of ALIS, the mission-critical information infrastructure supporting the global F-35 fleet by facilitating real-time transmission of aircraft health and maintenance data across a distributed logistics network.

Executed full software development life cycle (SDLC) activities including requirements analysis, system design, implementation, unit testing, and multi-platform integration.

Designed and implemented an internal Java Swing-based application to optimize workflows for the Maintenance Management team, reducing development bottlenecks and improving operational efficiency.

Developed front-end components and business logic for a high-availability web application, enabling secure and interactive exchange of aircraft maintenance and diagnostics data within an Model-View-Control(MVC) based architecture.

Integrated functionalities across multiple ALIS domains, including operations, maintenance, supply chain, training, and customer support services, to provide a seamless user experience.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure the scalability and reliability of ALIS, supporting over 200 F-35 aircraft and facilitating more than 90,000 flight hours globally.
